verdict.rationale: SerpApi explicitly supports markdown output 'optimized for LLMs and AI agents' with roughly half the token size of JSON, a field-selection parameter to reduce payload size, and explicitly markets a RAG use case ('Feed search data into AI pipelines to minimize hallucinations'), plus an llms.txt and MCP server for agent consumption. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming markdown output quality and ranking relevance in a real RAG pipeline, and no benchmark showing token/size reduction claims validated externally.
